title: Chapter 109
text:
"Rumble!"

A thunderstorm raged. The night sky was torn apart by the dazzling lightning, and the torrential rain poured down.

The rain narrowed the field of vision and greatly affected the accuracy of shooting. Weapons and equipment were prone to getting wet, so the mercenaries could only brace the storm and quickly cover the machine guns with waterproof cloths and move the ammunition into the roofed sheds.

The heavy rain filled the sky, and the sound of rain filled the ears. The bunker was filled with water vapor. Han Xiao moved away from the window to avoid being splashed. He looked at the sky outside, raised his eyebrows, and whispered, "This kind of bad weather is an obvious flag. If the next wave of strong enemies doesn't come now, I'll immediately …"

Halfway through his sentence, Brother Xiao hurriedly stopped himself. What a joke! How could he set up such an obvious poison healer?

"Vroom —" A series of engine sounds rang out in the rain. This time, the battle was fierce. More armored off-road vehicles drove in the heavy rain, and the dense raindrops hit the cold armor.

"Open fire!" The mercenaries in the manor roared. The machine guns and howitzers roared.

The next moment, even more ferocious firepower erupted from the enemy's fleet. A few small rockets hit the outer wall of the manor, blowing two machine guns and the operators into the sky!

Han Xiao fired while listening to Chen Li and the black man roaring through the walkie-talkie.

"The enemy has rockets, pay attention to avoid them! Machine gunners and howitzers, beat them up! "

"Snipers, hurry up and shoot, don't make me f * cking rush you! Hurry up and do something! "

"There are more than 20 local yachts on the river. People in the west, hurry up and stop them, don't let them get close to the shore!"

"F * ck, helicopters!"

The sound of rotors came from the sky. Two Y-5 Winged Snake armed helicopters invaded from the sky. Lightning flashed in the night sky, illuminating the ferocious appearance of the helicopters. The gunners wearing goggles controlled the large caliber six-barreled aviation cannon mounted on the side of the helicopter, bursting out terrifying firepower.

The bullets of the autocannon were almost equivalent to mini cannonballs. Their penetrative power and destructive power were not something that a normal machine gun could compare to. Their firing speed was also very fast. With a series of crackling sounds, the bullets formed an orange line as they swept downwards. The front of the manor was not of much use.

The mercenaries' casualties soared!

Curses, screams, roars, rain, gunshots, engines, and the rumbling of thunder formed a symphony of war, grand and tragic, chaotic and passionate.

The helicopter was the biggest threat. A portion of the machine gunners raised their guns to shoot at the aircraft.

With a simple lift, the Y-5 Winged Serpent was out of the range of ordinary machine guns. Some stray bullets could not penetrate the helicopter's armor.

"Sniper! Kill the pilot! "Chen Li roared.

"We'll deal with the helicopters. As for the other snipers, don't let the ground troops attack us!" The Hornet brothers in the central bunker gave the order over the communication network. Then, the two brothers started firing at the helicopter.

Even though the rain was hazy, Han Xiao could clearly see the sparks from the sniper rifle on the exterior armor of the helicopter. The pilot's window was made of highly resilient bulletproof glass, so it would take at least seven or eight shots to penetrate it.

Han Xiao suddenly felt that something was wrong. He quickly retracted his gun and backed away from the sniper's window.

"Don't leave your post without permission …" Big Beard roared when he saw this. However, before he could finish his sentence, a violent explosion interrupted him. The wall of the bunker exploded violently. Big Beard was directly sent flying by the shockwave and slammed into the wall on the other side. His arm was fractured and twisted, and he screamed in pain.

Two Y-5 Winged Serpents were equipped with four missiles used for air combat. They directly bombarded the three bunkers. The central bunker was focused and blasted into the sky, turning into a pile of ruins. The Hornet brothers were killed without a sound. Their flesh, blood, dust, and broken bricks were thrown out together.

The three bunkers were blown up!

Hmm … the sentence above sounded a little weird.

Without the threat of the snipers, the helicopters were like wild dogs in heat. They were even more rampant. The coverage of the firepower made the mercenaries not even dare to show their heads.

Although Han Xiao dodged, he was still shocked by the shockwave. He did not suffer much damage, but the sky above him was exposed to the enemy's vision. He was in a very bad situation.

The enemy had sea, land, and air forces. The manor was like a delicate young girl being attacked from three directions.

He turned his head to look at the tragic situation. His eyes darkened. "The mercenaries can't hold on anymore."

…

"The people outside can't hold on anymore."

In the center of River Valley Manor, in the hall of the villa, two men looked at the battle outside the window. One of them had his hands on the windowsill. This was a bald old man with white eyebrows and a beard. He wore black-rimmed glasses.

The other man stood diagonally behind the bald old man with his hands behind his back. He looked like a middle-aged man. His thick black hair was combed back, and only his temples were slightly white. If there was anything special about him, it would be his temperament. There was a faint smile on his face, and he looked very kind.

The kind man laughed. "Looks like I have to do something."

The bald old man nodded. "After guarding for so long, it's time for Xena to get rid of the traitor in the organization. My life is in your hands, old friend."

The kind man nodded. Just as he was about to walk out, he suddenly stopped and looked at the sudden change in the battle. His eyes were slightly surprised. "Seems like an interesting guy has appeared. I don't need to do anything."

"Hmm?" The bald old man was stunned for a moment and looked outside.

…

"Are there any snipers left alive? If we don't get rid of those two helicopters, we will all die here!" Chen Li hid in the fortification and roared into the walkie-talkie.

The two Y-5 Serpents were very rampant. Relying on the fact that no one could attack them, they took a dump on the mercenaries. They even wanted to directly bomb the villa in the middle of the manor.

Suddenly, a fiery red bullet pierced through the rain and accurately hit the side of one of the Y-5 Serpents. The bullet cracked and burst into flames in the rain.

High-explosive bullet!

"Boom!" The orange-red high-explosive gas flame seeped through the gaps in the protective equipment and ignited the ammunition chain. The helicopter, which had been proud of itself a moment ago, exploded in an instant. The cannons and ammunition exploded one after another. Using fire alone to ignite the bullets was not very powerful, but this was a bunch of large-caliber bullets. The power was equivalent to that of a fragmentation mine. The people inside the helicopter were all killed or injured. The flying shrapnel pierced through the pilot's neck, and blood splattered on the window like a fountain.

The helicopter spun and fell from the sky. The ground shook, and both sides of the battle were shaken.

In the ruins of the left bunker, Han Xiao, who had just fired the shot, pulled the bolt and ejected the smoking shell. His eyes were serious and calm. At the critical moment just now, he had put a lot of experience into [Sniper] and directly leveled it up to Level 9! That was why he was able to fire such a precise shot and hit the ammo of the machine gun from an extremely tricky angle!

This shot also led to bad consequences. The other Y-5 Serpent immediately focused its firepower on the left bunker. The enemy's ground forces knew very well that the helicopter was their biggest trump card, so they cooperated and focused their firepower. The terrifying wave of bullets shattered the rain and exploded on the left bunker.

Big Beard's face was pale. He thought he was going to be blown to death. With his two short legs, how could he be faster than the cannonballs? Just as he was in despair, he suddenly felt a big hand grab him by the back of his collar. A strong force pulled him up and left at lightning speed. The next moment, the entire left bunker was blown into ruins.

If he was a second slower, Big Beard would have turned into a pile of minced meat.

After escaping from danger, Big Beard found that the back of his collar was released and fell to the ground. He quickly looked back at the person who saved him. In the heavy rain, Han Xiao, dressed in black, jumped into his sight.

Big Beard did not have time to thank Han Xiao for saving his life. He said in shock, "How did you run so fast?"

"Because I am as free as the wind."

Big Beard was dumbfounded. What the f * ck are you talking about?

After Han Xiao finished talking casually, he slammed his feet on the ground. The soles of the electromagnetic levitation shoes lit up with a faint electric blue light, and the magnetic force erupted. He slid out like ice skating, faster than a car. In a few seconds, he stepped on the outer wall of the manor. In the shocked eyes of the mercenaries, he was like a black lightning, moving left and right on the wall. He could not be locked on at all, and the enemy's firepower was all dodged by him.

"Eat my Shadow Shifting Technique!"

Han Xiao sniped while moving at high speed. The shooting range here was several times wider than that of the left bunker. He had just leveled up to Level Nine, so he could control the whole situation. The electromagnetic levitation shoes provided very stable movement ability, and it did not need to be difficult to control. The difficulty was about the same as the electric pulley, so the high-speed movement did not have much impact on his accuracy.

High explosive bullets, shuttle-type penetrating bullets, Hayme bullets, and light stun bullets were fired one after another. These four types of bullets always appeared at the most needed places. One of the vehicles was about to fire a grenade at a machine gun position in the manor when a light stun bullet appeared at the most opportune moment. The strong light from the explosion caused the enemy to miss.

You are currently sniping on the move. You have learned some [Moving Sniping] techniques. (1/100)]

"You've learned a new skill?" Han Xiao's eyes lit up. This was a new skill that could only be activated when one was above level eight. He fired a few more shots and realized that hitting a target equated to one point of progress. Instantly, he became even more excited.

With the help of the Electromagnetic Levitation Shoes, he managed to avoid most of the attacks. However, the enemy was aware of his ability as a Sniper to control the situation. If they did not kill him, it would be difficult for them to move forward.

Therefore, Han Xiao felt the 'enthusiasm' of the enemy. Once again, he was focused on, and the pressure increased sharply. He was often hit by stray bullets and had to summon the magnetic retractable armor to protect his body.

The last Y-5 Serpent swayed left and right to prevent Han Xiao from sniping its vital parts. The cannons kept firing, and it did cause quite a lot of trouble for Han Xiao. Even with the magnetic retractable armor, it was very uncomfortable to take a few shots. The most disgusting thing was that the cannons had a knockback effect. The kinetic energy would push him away, and he had already missed a few shots.

The armor on his chest took three more shots from the cannons. Han Xiao's chest tightened, and he was pushed a few meters away. He almost fell off the wall, but the damage was not much. He now had more than two thousand HP, and together with the magnetic retractable armor, he was very tanky.

At this time, the mercenaries in the manor started to counterattack and took the initiative to cooperate with Han Xiao.
